research_findings: Discovered that the existing fetch retry mechanism in `fetchWithRetry` used a static delay, which could lead to thundering herd problems when multiple requests fail concurrently and retry at the same time.

Identified that the application was utilizing the `gemini-2.5-flash-lite` model for AI interactions, which could be upgraded to `gemini-2.5-flash` for improved reasoning and conversational quality during interviews.
features_improved: Optimized the `fetchWithRetry` utility by implementing exponential backoff with a maximum delay and randomized jitter. This enhancement mitigates the thundering herd effect and improves system resilience under load.
Upgraded the default LLM model from `gemini-2.5-flash-lite` to `gemini-2.5-flash` in both `src/lib/user-llm.ts` and `src/lib/langgraph.ts` to provide higher quality AI interview responses.
next_steps_for_next_run: Investigate upgrading Prisma and the `@prisma/adapter-pg` to their latest minor/patch versions.
Analyze the Excalidraw integration for potential lazy-loading optimizations to reduce initial bundle size.
Monitor error logs to verify the effectiveness of the exponential backoff implementation.
